description: A sprite sheet of SIXTEEN separate pixel art pieces arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows, each centered in its own cell. Row 1 pineapple plant growth from left to right: tiny spiky sprout, small spiky leaf rosette, larger rosette with a small green pineapple, big rosette topped with a ripe golden pineapple. Row 2 pink lotus growth in a small round water puddle: tiny lily pad, two lily pads with a closed bud, lily pads with a half open pink lotus, big fully bloomed pink lotus with a seed pod. Plants sit on a tiny dark soil mound. Row 3 item icons: a red prickly pear cactus fruit, three pale white-pink snow strawberries, a pale blue-white snow radish with leaves, a dark red fire melon with glowing orange cracks. Row 4 item icons: a golden pineapple, a green lotus seed pod, a bunch of brown dates, a brown coconut. Front view, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every piece fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
